delivery: IGN is requested first by the browser. On failure or after 2500 ms, the saved same-origin JPEG is used silently. Originals remain permanently with the project. The Node server acquires missing originals once; successful IGN images are not served a second time to visitors. Static hosting provides fallback for the preloaded coverage.
roof_projection: Georeferenced aerial photos projected on flat roof polygons triangulated from OSM, clipped at WMTS tile boundaries. Original courtyard holes retained. No facade photography or measured roof shapes.
